task.tr: Ailenizi anlatın. Ailenizde kaç kişi olduğunu, isimlerini, yaşlarını ve ne iş yaptıklarını yazın.

task.ru: Опишите свою семью. Напишите, сколько человек в вашей семье, как их зовут, сколько им лет и чем они занимаются.

body.taskEn: Write about your family. Say how many people are in your family, their names, their ages and what they do.

My father's name is...
My mother is ... years old.

I have one brother and one sister.

body.taskEn: Write about your favourite food. Say what it is, when you eat it, who makes it and why you like it.
hints: My favourite food is...
I eat it on Sundays.
My mother makes it.
It is hot and delicious.
I like it because...

body.taskEn: Write about your school or workplace. Say where it is, how you get there, what is there and what you like about it.
hints: My school is in the city centre.
I go there by bus.
There are twenty classrooms.
My teachers are friendly.
I like my English class.

hints: On Saturday I get up late.
I play football with my friends.
On Sunday I visit my grandparents.

topic: A message to a new friend
title: Hello, New Friend!

hints: Hi! My name is...
I am ... years old.
I live in Ashgabat with my family.
I like music and drawing.
What about you? What do you like?

task.ru: Опишите свой город или село. Большой он или маленький, что там есть (парк, магазин, школа…) и какое ваше любимое место.

body.taskEn: Write about your town or village. Is it big or small? What is there (a park, shops, a school…)? What is your favourite place?
hints: I live in a big city.
There is a beautiful park near my house.
There are many shops and cafés.
My favourite place is...
I go there with my friends.

task.tr: Hatırladığınız bir tatili anlatın. Nereye, kiminle gittiniz, neler yaptınız, hava nasıldı ve neden unutamadığınızı yazın (geçmiş zaman kullanın).

body.taskEn: Write about a holiday you remember. Where did you go and who with? What did you do? What was the weather like? Why do you remember it?
hints: Two years ago, I went to ... with my family.
We stayed in a small hotel near the sea.
Every day we swam and ate fresh fish.
The weather was hot and sunny.
I will never forget it because...

topic: An email to invite a friend
title: Come to My Party!

hints: Dear ..., I'm having a birthday party next Saturday.
It starts at 6 p.m. at my house.
We're going to play games and dance.
Could you bring some music?

task.tr: En iyi arkadaşınızı anlatın. Nasıl tanıştığınızı, dış görünüşünü, karakterini ve birlikte neler yaptığınızı yazın.

hints: I met my best friend at primary school.
She is tall and has long dark hair.
She is very funny and kind.
We often go to the cinema together.
I trust her because...

task.tr: Gelecek yaz için planlarınızı yazın. Nereye gideceğinizi, ne öğrenmek istediğinizi ve neler yapmayı planladığınızı anlatın (be going to / will kullanın).

If the weather is good, we will go camping.
I think it will be a great summer.

task.tr: Son izlediğiniz bir film hakkında kısa bir yorum yazın. Filmin adı, konusu, sevdiğiniz ve sevmediğiniz şeyler ve başkalarına önerip önermediğinizi yazın.

body.taskEn: Write a short review of a film you watched recently. Give the name, say what it is about, what you liked and didn't like, and whether you recommend it.
hints: Last week I watched a film called...

The ending was a bit boring.

hints: Last Sunday the internet didn't work all day.
At first I was bored because I couldn't...

I talked to my family more than usual.
In the end, it was a nice day because...

task.ru: Как лучше всего учить иностранный язык? Опишите как минимум три способа, приведите примеры из своего опыта и объясните, какой считаете самым эффективным.

body.taskEn: What is the best way to learn a foreign language? Describe at least three methods, give examples from your own experience and explain which one you think works best.
hints: There are many ways to learn a language, but...
Firstly, watching films with subtitles helps you...

hints: The person who inspires me most is...

body.taskEn: Write an article for your school magazine: Is social media good or bad for young people? Describe the positive and negative sides with examples and give your own opinion.
hints: Nowadays almost every teenager uses...

task.tr: Şu cümleyle biten kısa bir hikâye yazın: "…and when I opened the door, I couldn't believe my eyes." Geçmiş zamanları (past simple, past continuous, past perfect) kullanın.

hints: It was a cold, rainy evening and I was...
